Apple reports fourth quarter results

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $102.5 billion, up 8 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.85, up 91 percent year over year.

“Our September quarter set a revenue record,” said the Company’s CEO.

“Operating cash flow was $29.7 billion for the quarter,” said the CFO. “We returned over $24 billion to shareholders.”

Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock.

Outlook

For the December quarter of fiscal 2027, the Company expects total revenue to grow 10 to 12 percent year over year and gross margin to be between 47 and 48 percent.
